_rule: Prepared BEFORE the run (AGENTS.md); revised 2026-11-09 after he1 #2 (02:04, VALID). One Test Dialogue1 launch, RTX Hair bundle on, rr_post=1. Windows a-off/c-off: rr_hair_strand_aa=0; b-aa/d-aa: 2; e-untag: 1; f-debug: 3; static K8 bursts burst-off (0) and burst-aa (2), now full bursts with the RR inputs (pan_edge=0, pan_inputs=1). Flicker = py -3 tools/hair_groom/temporal_burst.py <burst-off> <burst-aa> --labels off,aa, plus the edge band (1-2 px ring of the class-5 mask) vs the hair core on the final image. Edge evidence = Xr ('Xr (RR colour: dither-resolved X)', its id in the log) against CBT (the compose output) on the class-5 mask. Cost = '[rrpost] gpu: render-res chain' aa minus off (the snapshot runs at the lighting pass, outside that line: its cost shows in the frame time only).

Strand edges flicker twice as much as the hair core: the user's report quantified

design change: strand_snapshot at the lighting pass writes (coverage, strand pixel, footprint) per pixel into a frame-parity image; strand_resolve reads only that image. Log line '[rrpost] strand snapshots (rr_hair_strand_aa=N): S at the lighting pass, R refused'.

f-debug (rr_hair_strand_aa=3).predicted: red on the strand footprint (the hair cards' strand pixels and the background between them), yellow (red + green) on strand pixels, white/blue tint where the coverage applies along the silhouette; grey (x 0.25) elsewhere
f-debug (rr_hair_strand_aa=3).invalid_if: no snapshot line with S > 0, or no Xr dump in the f-debug trace

flicker (burst-aa vs burst-off).predicted: edge-band flicker of the final image 10-30% lower with the key (offline 0.0178 -> 0.0086 on edge pixels); temporal_burst mc final on the hair region lower; core unchanged within the off/aa spread
flicker (burst-aa vs burst-off).kept_if: edge flicker lower with aa than off and the user sees no dithering on strand silhouettes in the d-aa PNG vs c-off

static (b/d vs a/c).predicted: Xr differs from CBT on the hair ring in every aa window (several thousand pixels at render size, hundreds in the previews), 0 in the off windows

energy (a/c vs b/d character ROI).rejected_if: |mean(b, d) - mean(a, c)| > 2% of the ROI mean

cost.predicted: render-res chain +0.05 to +0.2 ms (the resolve's 25 snapshot and colour taps on footprint pixels); snapshot 0.05-0.2 ms at lighting
